subject: [hw] DONE V30 rev 2: unsigned sign-flag bug fixed, fuzz test added
body:
DONE V30 rev 2.

Change since rev 1: I ran an additional 30000-case randomized differential fuzz against the host printf (now committed as test_v30/t_fuzz.c, fixed seed, one aggregate check). It found a real bug: the "+" and " " flags were being applied to unsigned conversions (%u %x %X %o), where C ignores them (e.g. "%+x" of 0x80 printed "+80" instead of "80"). Fixed in emit_int (sign flags only for signed conversions) and covered by four new templates ("%+x", "% u", "%+o", "% 08lx") in the description-table test. The heap and string shims were not affected.

Test command (from the work tree root):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v30/run_tests.sh
Last line:
  N2TEST V30 PASS 277618/277618
All four builds report 277618/277618 (ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan, -DV30_NO_VFS). ~17 s, builds only under /tmp/n2hw-v30.

STATUS.md updated with the new count, the fuzz, and the bug. The not-done list is unchanged: real V02/V03 end-to-end run, llvm-mc-assembled qsort comparator (host hook for now), arm64 iOS compile check, %lc/%ls/positional/%a, and munmap not releasing guest pages.
